segments.oily: The few reviewers with oily skin say a small amount goes a long way and suggest lightening other routine steps in warm weather so the serum doesn't feel heavy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in a dry climate and one with dry winter skin, describe the serum as strongly hydrating and moisturizing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it absorbs to a light, satin-matte finish and caused no breakouts or redness for them.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say the formula didn't irritate them despite their sensitivity, while others report mild burning, redness, or eye irritation, with one limiting use to her neck.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature, aging, or 40s-plus skin report firmer, plumper skin and softer fine lines after several weeks, though a few in this group say they saw little change in their deeper wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report softer fine lines and improved firmness or plumpness within two to several weeks, including around the eyes and forehead; a handful say they saw no meaningful change in their wrinkles or deep lines even after weeks of daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as strongly hydrating, easing dry patches, dry winter skin, or dry-climate dryness, with several noting the hydrated feeling lasts through the day.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report mild, short-lived redness or burning after application, including around the eyes; most others explicitly note no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers say the serum leaves a noticeable moisture barrier that keeps skin comfortable through the day and simplifies their nighttime routine.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who mentions spots directly reports her brown spots and dullness improved alongside her wrinkles after using the serum and matching cream.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers say they had no breakouts or reactions, one reports a temporary increase in breakouts that resolved with continued use, and one reports the serum gave her a bit of acne with no other improvement.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who addresses oiliness directly says the serum suits oily skin but suggests scaling back other routine steps in summer to avoid a heavy feel.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance is strong and can irritate sensitive skin
High price relative to visible results
Pump dispenser is precise and hygienic

extraits.texte: I was really excited to get these! One half of my face is much less firm and plump than the other, from a broken cheek bone, so it's something I miss about having my bone structure in tact haha. But I have used this for almost a month now and see no difference in my problem areas… if anything, it gave me a bit of acne. Maybe I used too much ? Texture of the day cream is really nice and feels good and hydrating to put on.

extraits.titre: I really wanted to love this
extraits.texte: First of all I think it's amazing that Dior gave both the serum and the cream to influensters to try. I love the packaging of these products. And I really wanted to love the products but I think I may be a tad allergic. I would put them on every day for a week in the morning before work. I definitely noticed a change in my skin. It was brighter and more hydrated. But by the end of the day my eyes would be burning. The only way I could find relief is if I just washed my face and used eye drops. I tried going a day without these products to see if they were the issue and my eyes didn't burn when I wasn't wearing the product. Maybe a sensitive skin solution is something that Dior can look into next?

I have been using the Dior Serum for a couple of weeks to ensure a fair review. For the price point I was expecting magic in a bottle. Although it didn't sweep me off my feet I did see some results. The thick creamy serum did moisturize my dry winter skin. I did notice smaller pores and plumper skin. I'm in my 30's and don't have defined wrinkles yet but did not notice much difference on the creases I have around my eyes. I do love that most of the ingredients are natural. There is a very light scent which isn't the best but not terrible either. The packaging is gorgeous and very sleek although it's irritating to see the finger prints on it after handling it. Overall I liked the serum just not something I would buy myself.

This serum smells divine. It's a lightweight texture that absorbs flawlessly. I will note that I have sensitive skin and was not able to use this consistently on my face without mild irritation - so I primarily use on my neck instead, but for a neck serum it definitely holds its own

Being in my 40's, I am looking for skin products that will help with moisture, elasticity and texture. This product feels nice on aging mature male skin. My skin tends to feel very dry after spending a lot of time outside, this product brings that moisture back to the skin. It's a very light textured serum that melts into the skin, but the effects are visible. I'm not into highly scented products, but this one is nice and subtle. My wife wanted me to mention that she thinks the packaging brings elegance to the bathroom counter top. Apparently, that last point helps the ladies with their picks. I enjoy trying these products and finding what works for male skin.

extraits.titre: Dior Capture Le Serum Night and Day for skin firmness
extraits.texte: I received the newly designed Dior Capture Le Serum night and day products to try for free. Did the new design improve the original recipe? I believe it did. It is the same signature scent but now in a luxurious chrome glass bottle. Somewhat puzzled why Dior uses silver when the name is of French origin meaning golden. Unless it is because Dior prefers gray tones and silver hints at that color range. Regardless the non tacky readily absorbent serum is dispensed through a pump for nighttime application. The day cream comes with a tiny spoon and is thicker in texture for use on the neck and face. I did not experience any break out or redness of my combination skin nor experience any excessive dryness. It has a cooling effect on my face and does seem to smooth my fine lines so they are less noticeable. Time will tell if the OX-C technology is effective compared to other retinal serums for wrinkle correcting and firming results. I love the scent, the chic stunning bottle and jar, and the results on my skin to date.

Lotion-like texture, lightweight and hydrating, with good spreadability and quick absorption. It doesn't feel sticky on the skin and is suitable for most skin types (including dry and combination skin). Oily skin may need to reduce follow-up skincare steps in summer to avoid heaviness. Pairs well with sunscreen during the day without pilling, but it's best used at night. The fragrance is mild and non-irritating.
